title: Eureka Service Registry
blurb: A Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka server that lets microservices find each other without hard-coded addresses, packaged to run as a container.
description: A standalone service-discovery server built on Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka. Services register themselves at startup and resolve their peers by logical name, so instances can move, scale, or restart without anyone editing a config file full of hostnames.
